question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is '**expand**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses the population of the Colonies during a four-year period.
 
• The blank requires a verb that fits the idea of population change over time.
 
• "**Expand**" means to increase in size or number, which fits the idea of population growth.
 
• Other options ("**condense**", "**constrict**", "**shrink**") mean to decrease or become smaller, which do not fit as the sentence says the population “didn’t _____ much.”

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

Complete Passage: *The volume of tea imports into the Colonies rose at a very fast rate in the four years following up to the Boston Tea Party. They went from 55 tonnes in 1770, which was close to the amount dumped in the harbour, to 370 tonnes the year the tea was dumped. This was an increase of almost seven times. The population of the Colonies was about 2 million people in 1770 and didn’t **expand__** much in that four-year period. Basic economics tells us this sharp increase in supply without more customers meant the price of tea had to fall.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Condense: Means to make something denser or more compact, not suitable for population growth context.
 
• Constrict: Means to make narrower or tighter, not appropriate for discussing population changes.
 
• Shrink: Means to become smaller, the opposite of what is needed for the intended meaning in the passage.
